Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a ballistics imaging data base.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ballistics imaging; amending RCW 43.43.500 and43.43.510; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any manufacturer or importer licensed bythe United States secretary of the treasury that ships or transports apistol or rifle to be sold, rented, or transferred in the state shallinclude in the box with the firearm in a separate sealed container: (a) A projectile discharged from that firearm; (b) A spent cartridge casing of the projectile discharged from thatfirearm; and (c) Additional information that identifies the specific firearm andcartridge as required by chief of the Washington state patrol. (2) Upon receipt of a pistol or rifle from the manufacturer orimporter, the dealer shall confirm to the Washington state patrol that the manufacturer or importer complied with subsection (1) of thissection. (3) Upon the sale or transfer of the pistol or rifle, the dealershall forward the sealed container to the Washington state patrol crime p. 1 SB 5315information center. The crime information center shall enter theballistics image and other required information in a ballistics imagingdata base. (4) The chief of the Washington state patrol shall adopt rules tocarry out the provisions of this section. (5) For the purposes of this section, "ballistics image" means theunique characteristics that each firearm imprints on projectiles andspent cartridge casings.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.43.500 and 1998 c 67 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There is established the Washington state crime information centerto be located in the records division of the Washington state patroland to function under the direction of the chief of the Washingtonstate patrol. The center shall serve to coordinate crime information,by means of data processing, for all law enforcement agencies in thestate. It shall make such use of the facilities of the law enforcementteletype system as is practical. It shall provide access to thenational crime information center, to motor vehicle and driver licenseinformation, to the sex offender central registry, to the ballisticsimaging data base, and to such other public records as may be accessedby data processing and which are pertinent to law enforcement.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.43.510 and 1998 c 67 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: As soon as is practical and feasible there shall be established, bymeans of data processing, files listing stolen and wanted vehicles,outstanding warrants, identifying children whose parents, custodians,or legal guardians have reported as having run away from home or thecustodial residence, identifiable stolen property, files maintainingthe central registry of sex offenders required to register underchapter 9A.44 RCW, files maintaining the ballistics imaging data base,and such other files as may be of general assistance to law enforcementagencies.
